rohs.note: Aluminium housing with no restricted substances identified. Compliant with RoHS 2 (2011/65/EU).

reach.note: No SVHC substances identified in aluminium alloy.

conflict_minerals.note: Aluminium is not a conflict mineral under OECD guidelines.

rohs.note: Motor assembly meets RoHS 2 requirements per manufacturer declaration (ED-M3K-400V datasheet rev. 4.1).

svhc_substances: Neodymium (Nd) — rare earth permanent magnet material
reach.note: Neodymium is listed on the EU Critical Raw Materials (CRM) list 2023. Over 85% of global neodymium production is in China, creating a single-source supply resilience risk. Not an SVHC restriction today but flagged for supply chain due diligence.

conflict_minerals.note: Rare earth elements in permanent magnets require supply chain due diligence under OECD Due Diligence Guidance.

rohs.note: Brass alloy grade not declared on FC-CV-12B datasheet. Standard leaded brass (CuZn39Pb3) contains up to 3% lead — this exceeds the RoHS 0.1% limit for homogeneous materials.
rohs.action_required: Request RoHS compliance declaration from FluidCorp. If switching supplier, specify lead-free brass alloy (e.g. CuZn21Si3P) explicitly in the purchase order.

svhc_substances: Lead (Pb) — potential presence in brass alloy
reach.note: Lead is a REACH SVHC (Annex XIV candidate). If lead content exceeds 0.1% by weight in any homogeneous material, Article 33 communication obligations apply to downstream customers.

conflict_minerals.note: Brass (copper/zinc alloy) is not a conflict mineral.
